# [TASK] Close validation gaps from closed issues #4, #5, #14

## Task
Close validation gaps found in a 2026-07-21 audit of issues previously closed as done: #4 (GitHub setup), #5 (Docker Compose), #14 (shared library).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] #5: `infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml` (resource-limited override) exists; Adminer, Mongo Express and Redis Commander run only under the `dev-tools` compose profile; `infrastructure/scripts/logs.sh` exists; `env.example` is renamed to `.env.example` (`ls infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml infrastructure/scripts/logs.sh infrastructure/docker/.env.example`; `grep -c 'profiles: \["dev-tools"\]' infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml` — 3)
- [x] #14: `@LogExecutionTime`, `@ValidateRequest`, `@CacheResult`, `@RateLimited` — bare unused annotations with no aspect implementation, redundant with Spring's own `@Cacheable`, Bucket4j rate limiting, and `@Valid`/`@Validated` — are deleted from the shared library's code and docs (`grep -rl 'LogExecutionTime\|ValidateRequest\|CacheResult\|RateLimited' backend/shared-library` — no matches)
- [x] #14: all 6 exception classes plus `ErrorResponse` and `HalResource` have tests (`./gradlew :backend:shared-library:test`, run by `backend-ci.yml` on every push)
- [x] #4: the decision to run without branch protection (single collaborator, no second approver needed to merge) is documented in `AGENTS.md`'s "Merging to main" section; ARCHITECTURE.md §9 no longer restates process decisions and points there instead (`AGENTS.md`: "one collaborator means there's no second approver needed")
- [x] #4: the `project-automation.yml` CI failure was descoped to #28, not fixed here (#28)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
#12 (config service Git backend) was reopened separately; #16 (movie-service failing tests) was fixed in commit `ca87c10` — neither is this issue's scope.

The second criterion above was true in code but not in docs: `backend/shared-library/README.md` still documented the four deleted annotations with full usage examples. Removed as part of this audit.
